name: Podia
tagline: Creator platform for courses, digital products, email, and memberships

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked; public 2026 sources list Mover around $49/month monthly or $42/month annually, with transaction fees on lower tier.

verdictSummary: Selling a few digital downloads or a course is buildable, but Podia bundles checkout, file delivery, courses, email, memberships, affiliates, and support.
coreLoopDIY: Build product pages, Stripe checkout, gated downloads/course lessons, customer accounts, and email receipts.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because commerce plus content delivery has lots of edge cases.

prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Podia (Creator platform for courses, digital products, email, and memberships). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build product pages, Stripe checkout, gated downloads/course lessons, customer accounts, and email receipts.
- Needs: Stripe.
- Needs: file storage.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: hosted site.
- Needs: email service.
- Needs: course/content database.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: checkout/product UX; course hosting; email marketing.
